response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but his background is heavily skewed toward JavaScript/TypeScript, D, and web/mobile development rather than C++. His recent roles focus on full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure, with limited evidence of deep C++ expertise, secure industrial cybersecurity practices (IEC 62443), or cloud platform solutions for automation machinery. While he demonstrates strong software craftsmanship and problem-solving, the alignment with the specific C++ and industrial automation requirements is weak.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship with TDD, CI/CD, and agile methodologies
Experience with high-performance and low-latency systems (e.g., DLang, asynchronous I/O)
Proven ability to mentor teams and contribute to open-source projects
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience and no clear evidence of STL or object-oriented design in C++
No direct experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or secure development lifecycles
Lack of exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure) or industrial automation protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850)
